description: Search YouTube videos by query. Returns up to 50 results with title, channel, views, duration, and URL. Supports filtering by uploadDate (today/week/month/year) and videoDuration (short/medium/long), and sorting by relevance, date, viewCount, or rating. Served by the provider selected with YT_PROVIDER; with the default innertube provider some options are approximated and reported in warnings.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-50)

sortBy.description: Sort order: 'relevance' (default), 'date', 'viewCount' (most popular), or 'rating'. With the default innertube provider, 'date' keeps relevance order and 'rating' sorts by popularity, each with a warning; the api provider applies all four exactly.

uploadDate.description: Filter by upload date: 'any', 'hour', 'today', 'week', 'month', 'year'. With the innertube provider, 'hour' is applied as 'today' with a warning.

name: search_youtube

warnings.description: Requested options that YouTube search could not apply exactly
